    fix(tui_gateway): resume on the route in model_config.gateway_runtime (#125942, salvage #125956)
    
    tui_gateway/server.py::_stored_session_runtime_overrides read only the top-level model_config
    keys and then fell back to billing_provider (frozen at the first accounted call), never the
    nested gateway_runtime dict gateway/run_turn.py persists per turn — so a Telegram-driven session
    resumed on Desktop paired the current model with the first-call provider and 404'd. Route the
    Desktop/TUI reader through the canonical SessionDB.session_gateway_runtime (nested gateway_runtime,
    then top-level TUI keys, then billing_provider), the same reader CLI --resume uses; the reader now
    fills a missing top-level provider from billing_provider so the pre-existing TUI contract
    (top-level base_url/api_mode + billing_provider) is unchanged. Redone slim from #125956, which
    kept a second hand-rolled reader and inverted the precedence.
    
    red-on-base: tests/tui_gateway/test_resume_switched_provider_endpoint.py::
    test_resume_honors_gateway_runtime_over_first_call_billing_provider and
    test_resume_prefers_gateway_runtime_over_stale_top_level_keys fail on origin/main with
    `assert ('anthropic', None, None) == ('openai-codex', None, 'codex_responses')`; green-on-head.
